description: This file contains unit tests for the StorageManager component, specifically testing storage creation, deletion, and clearing functionalities via RPC mechanisms. It uses Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to simulate filesystem interactions and verify correct behavior of storage management operations, including handling of edge cases like invalid app IDs and missing storage directories.

classes.name: StorageManagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for storage manager related unit tests, managing setup and teardown of storage service mocks and RPC connections.

methods.name: CreateStorageManagerInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Initializes RPC client and server proxies to connect to the storage manager service.

methods.name: ReleaseStorageManagerInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Releases and cleans up RPC proxies and interfaces.
